caveats: AC-C0-5 deliberate-divergence behavioral verification deferred to S8 (same pattern as prior stories). Implementation is structurally sound.
implementation_summary: Extended assertC0 with three new settled-state equality checks (AC-C0-2: members set equality via new Set; AC-C0-3: epoch equality; AC-C0-4: per-pubkey leaf-count equality across A and B). All three checks are guarded by `if (!m.groupIdA || !m.groupIdB) return` and appended after the unchanged task-subset assertions (AC-C0-1 preservation). Replaced assertS5 body (S1's partial model-flag-based form) with the hook-based full biconditional (AC-S5-5): uses getGroupMembersHook as production truth source and getPubkeyLeafCountHook for leaf count, asserting `membersA.includes(p) === (leafCount >= 1)` for every p in {pubkeyA, pubkeyB}. Added getGroupEpochHook, getGroupMembersHook, and getPubkeyLeafCountHook to the import block from ../fixtures/two-party.js.
ac_c0_5_deliberate_divergence_note: AC-C0-5 behavioral verification deferred to S8 per spec. The assertC0 implementation uses strict `expect(epochA).toBe(epochB)` and `expect(lcA).toBe(lcB)` — any divergence in these values would cause immediate assertion failure. The `new Set(membersA!).toEqual(new Set(membersB!))` deep-equality check catches member-set divergence. These assertions are structurally sound for catching the divergence scenarios AC-C0-5 describes.
